name: Plain Loop
tagline: Say only what moves, what causes what, and when.

lexicon.meaning: moves, flows or is sent to. Chains: A to B to C.
returns to an earlier step (rework or repeat).
next step starts only after the previous step finishes.
the paths listed after it run in parallel, at the same time.
join: wait until every parallel path finishes (use all done for 3 or more).
delay or count before the next thing: after 2 weeks, after 3 failures.
an amount that builds up over time; inflow raises it, outflow lowers it.
a loop that amplifies its own change: growth feeds more growth.
a loop that pulls back toward a target or limit.

rules.rule: Comparative pairs show cause: more A, more B means more A causes more B. Any comparative works: less, higher, slower.
rules.reads_as: more rain causes a higher river

rules.rule: A cause chain followed by a colon and a loop type feeds back to its first item. Types: reinforcing loop, balancing loop. Standing alone as a statement, it names the loop just described.
rules.example: more sales, more ads: reinforcing loop
rules.reads_as: more sales bring more ads, which bring more sales; self-amplifying

rules.rule: Conditions: if C, X. Use else for the other case. Semicolons separate branches. Compare with over, below, at.
rules.example: if level over 80, alarm; else wait
rules.reads_as: if the level exceeds 80 the alarm sounds, otherwise keep waiting

rules.rule: A colon introduces parts or details of the word before it. A system has subsystems: list them.
rules.reads_as: the city is a system with two subsystems, north and south

rules.rule: Drop articles and filler words. Every other word keeps its plain English meaning.
Commas list steps or effects in the order they happen. A period ends one statement.
rules.example: if cold, heater on, raises heat
rules.reads_as: when cold, the heater turns on and raises the heat

translations.b1: more customers, more referrals: reinforcing loop, no limit.
translations.b2: compare room temperature to target. if colder, heater on, raises it; if at target, heater off. balancing loop.
translations.b3: tank water level is stock: inflow by inlet, outflow by drain. if inflow over outflow, rises; if under, falls.
translations.b4: if inventory below target, shop orders. delivery after 2 week delay, so over-ordering; inventory oscillates around target.
translations.b5: collect data, then clean, then analyze, then publish results.
translations.b6: check each incoming request: if valid, to processing; else reject, notify sender.
translations.b7: order splits in parallel: packing, billing. both done, then shipping.
translations.b8: more population, more births: reinforcing loop. more population, less food each, higher death rate, slower growth: balancing loop. population levels off at carrying capacity.
translations.b9: attempt job. if fails, wait, retry. after 3 failures, to human review.
translations.b10: factory has subsystems: intake, assembly, quality check. parts from suppliers to intake to assembly to quality check; finished to customers; defective back to assembly.
